description: Search products that can be bought online from Austrian businesses using fixfind Shop (shops embedded in the merchants' own websites: farm shops, food, crafts, garden, pet supplies ...). Product data is German, so search with German words (e.g. "Honig", "Kürbiskernöl", "Teichfilter"); all words must match. Prices are gross in EUR incl. VAT ("from" = cheapest variant). Returns summaries with the product url; use get_product for description, variants, shipping and payment. Buying happens on the merchant's website: give the user the product url.

query.description: German search words, e.g. "Waldhonig". Optional – without it all products are listed.

name: search_products
title: Produkte in Shops suchen
